scientific_integrity: A complete analytic proof and a separately identified exact-rational finite sanity check accompany the theorem; no independent validation has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Real scalars; nonempty first-countable locally compact Hausdorff K for equivalence. Failure requires only a nontrivial convergent sequence. No statement about spaces without such sequences or about lower adjoints.
title: Discreteness exactly characterizes universal second-adjoint norm attainment in real \(C_0(K)\) for first-countable locally compact spaces
